name: Old Josué Le Brocq

intro.text: Bouônjour. Seventy years I've farmed these steep fields. I won the Battle of Flowers with a float made entirely of hydrangeas. I once told the Bailiff he was in the wrong field, and he agreed.

win: Well. The old man's been put in his place. Mèrcie bein des fais, my friend. That's thanks, and it's meant.
after: Come back in April and I'll give you the first Royals of the year. Boiled, with butter, nothing else. A man could cry.
